shortDescription: Configuration for SSL service group resource.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: commonname
options.description: Name to be checked against the CommonName (CN) field in the server certificate bound to the SSL server

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: ocspstapling
options.description: State of OCSP stapling support on the SSL virtual server. Supported only if the protocol used is higher than SSLv3. Possible values: C(ENABLED): The appliance sends a request to the OCSP responder to check the status of the server certificate and caches the response for the specified time. If the response is valid at the time of SSL handshake with the client, the OCSP-based server certificate status is sent to the client during the handshake. C(DISABLED): The appliance does not check the status

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: sendclosenotify
options.description: Enable sending SSL Close-Notify at the end of a transaction

options.name: serverauth
options.description: State of server authentication support for the SSL service group.

options.name: servicegroupname
options.description: Name of the SSL service group for which to set advanced configuration.

options.name: sessreuse
options.description: State of session reuse. Establishing the initial handshake requires CPU-intensive public key encryption operations. With the C(ENABLED) setting, session key exchange is avoided for session resumption requests received from the client.

options.name: sesstimeout
options.description: Time, in seconds, for which to keep the session active. Any session resumption request received after the timeout period will require a fresh SSL handshake and establishment of a new SSL session.

options.name: snienable
options.description: State of the Server Name Indication (SNI) feature on the service. SNI helps to enable SSL encryption on multiple domains on a single virtual server or service if the domains are controlled by the same organization and share the same second-level domain name. For example, *.sports.net can be used to secure domains such as login.sports.net and help.sports.net.

options.name: ssl3
options.description: State of SSLv3 protocol support for the SSL service group. Note: On platforms with SSL acceleration chips, if the SSL chip does not support SSLv3, this parameter cannot be set to C(ENABLED).

options.name: sslclientlogs
options.description: This parameter is used to enable or disable the logging of additional information, such as the Session ID and SNI names, from SSL handshakes to the audit logs.

options.name: sslprofile
options.description: Name of the SSL profile that contains SSL settings for the Service Group.

options.name: sslservicegroup_ecccurve_binding
options.description: Bindings for sslservicegroup_ecccurve_binding resource

options.name: sslservicegroup_sslcacertbundle_binding
options.description: Bindings for sslservicegroup_sslcacertbundle_binding resource

options.name: sslservicegroup_sslcertkey_binding
options.description: Bindings for sslservicegroup_sslcertkey_binding resource

options.name: sslservicegroup_sslcipher_binding
options.description: Bindings for sslservicegroup_sslcipher_binding resource

options.name: sslservicegroup_sslciphersuite_binding
options.description: Bindings for sslservicegroup_sslciphersuite_binding resource

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: strictsigdigestcheck
options.description: Parameter indicating to check whether peer's certificate is signed with one of signature-hash combination supported by Citrix ADC

options.name: tls1
options.description: State of TLSv1.0 protocol support for the SSL service group.

options.name: tls11
options.description: State of TLSv1.1 protocol support for the SSL service group.

options.name: tls12
options.description: State of TLSv1.2 protocol support for the SSL service group.

options.name: tls13
options.description: State of TLSv1.3 protocol support for the SSL service group.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
